author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: ततः किमित्यत आह ॥ नियतमिति । हि यस्मादकर्मणः कर्माकरणात्कर्मानुष्ठानंज्यायः प्रशस्ततमम् । अतो नियतं वर्णाश्रमोचितं कर्म कुरु । किञ्चाकर्मणः कर्माकुर्वतः ते तव शरीरयात्राऽपि देहनिर्वाहोऽपि न प्रसिद्ध्येदित्यर्थः ॥ ३.८॥
translation:
Do thou the appointed duty; for to do is better than not to do; and, even to keep body and soul together may not be possible for thee not-working. (8)
A. "By Karma (action) the icing is bound downs; and by knowledge he becomes free, Therefore the ascetics that perceive the end do not perform Karma," The third position of Arjuna based upon this Smriti is disposed of below,
